Name: Home Weather Station
Author: Stefan Schwetschke
Description: Shows indoor and outdoor temperature, humidity, CO2, noise, pressure, rain, wind and trends from a Netatmo weather station on your keys. Unofficial: independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Netatmo, Elgato or Corsair.

Actions.Name: Temperature
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a temperature. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute) and to see today's minimum and maximum.

Actions.Name: Humidity
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the relative humidity. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute).

Actions.Name: CO2
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the indoor CO2 concentration. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute).

Actions.Name: Noise
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the indoor noise level. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute).

Actions.Name: Pressure
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the air pressure. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute).

Actions.Name: Rain
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the rainfall of the last 24 hours. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute).

Actions.Name: Wind
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the wind speed and direction. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute).

Actions.Name: Focus Display
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the value of the focused sensor. Follows the focus set by the navigation keys and the dial. Press to request fresh data (at most once a minute). No alerts: a threshold fits one value, and this key changes value with the focus.

Actions.Name: Reload
Actions.Tooltip: Fetches the newest data the cloud has (at most one real request per minute). It cannot make the station measure: stations upload about every 10 minutes. Shows how old the data is.

Actions.Name: Next Value
Actions.Tooltip: Moves the focus to the next value of the same sensor (for example temperature, then humidity). Shows which value comes next.

Actions.Name: Previous Value
Actions.Tooltip: Moves the focus to the previous value of the same sensor. Shows which value comes before.

Actions.Name: Next Sensor
Actions.Tooltip: Keeps the value and moves the focus to the next sensor of the station that reports it (for example indoor, then outdoor temperature). Dimmed when there is no other sensor.

Actions.Name: Previous Sensor
Actions.Tooltip: Keeps the value and moves the focus to the previous sensor of the station that reports it. Dimmed when there is no other sensor.

Actions.Name: Next Station
Actions.Tooltip: Moves the focus to the next weather station of the account. Dimmed when the account has only one station.

Actions.Name: Previous Station
Actions.Tooltip: Moves the focus to the previous weather station of the account. Dimmed when the account has only one station.

Actions.Name: Auto Rotate
Actions.Tooltip: Press to switch on or off: the focus then advances through the values of the focused sensor every few seconds. Off after a restart unless set to start on.

Actions.Name: Data Age and Battery
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how old the data of the focused sensor is. Press to switch to its battery level (where the sensor reports one).

Actions.Name: History
Actions.Tooltip: Draws the recent course of the focused value (rain as bars). Press to switch between 6 hours, 24 hours and 3 days. Fetches history from the cloud only while visible.

Actions.Name: Weather Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn for the next value, press for the next sensor, turn while pressed for the next station. Tap the strip to request fresh data (at most once a minute), hold it for minimum and maximum or the 24 hour history.

TriggerDescription.Touch: Tap: reload (once a minute at most), hold: min/max or history
